title: On-call Brieflet: Cost-guided Alert Triage with Postmortem Anchors
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Problem: On-call responders currently switch between the alert list, cost dashboards, and the postmortem authoring flow during incidents. This context switching slows TTR and obscures cost signals that could inform remediation choices. Goal: Design a lightweight 'brieflet' surface attached to alerts in the console that surfaces: (1) immediate cost signal (estimated token/compute burn for active actions), (2) suggested remediation steps ranked by low-latency vs low-cost tradeoffs, (3) one-click links to create a postmortem stub or attach incident notes, and (4) quick handoff payload to transfer context to the next on-call. Scope: console UI only (no infra changes), prototype interactions in Figma, and an exploratory usability test with 6 SREs/product engineers. Out of scope: automated cost estimators requiring backend model changes (will be handled in ENG-19834).
acceptance_criteria: Prototype includes compact brieflet attached to alert row and expanded modal with remediation options
Brieflet displays estimated token and GPU cost range for recommended actions (low/medium/high) with explanatory tooltip
A 'Create Postmortem Stub' action pre-populates title, incident summary, and links to the alert; clicking creates a draft in Confluence (mock endpoint) and returns URL
Handoff payload exports responder, summary snippet, last 5 logs link, and chosen remediation into a clipboard-friendly format
Usability test median task completion time reduced by >=15% versus baseline for triage+handoff tasks
design_notes: Favor a compact on-row affordance (icon + badge) to avoid increasing alert list density; expand to modal for deeper actions
Cost signal is intentionally approximate: show range bands (low/med/high) and encourage conservative defaults rather than exact numbers
Tradeoff: deeper automation (auto-postmortem creation) adds backend complexity; we surface mock 'create stub' that calls a documented endpoint for later ENG hookup
Accessibility: ensure keyboard focus lands on brieflet controls and that modal supports screen reader annotations for cost signals
Rollout plan: feature flag gating per-org, with telemetry events for acceptance criteria tracking (prototype will include event stubs)
Privacy: no customer logs are surfaced in brieflet by default; only links to existing log ingestion dashboards are shown
usability_test_notes: Recruitment: 6 participants (3 SREs, 2 product engineers, 1 support engineer)
Tasks: triage alert, pick remediation optimizing for cost, create postmortem stub, handoff to colleague
Key findings: participants valued single-click postmortem start and cost bands; some confusion around 'estimated cost' wording => rename to 'estimated compute impact'
Action items from test: update copy, add hover explanation for remediation ranking, reduce modal depth from 3 to 2 steps
implementation_notes: ENG-19834 will expose cost band metadata on alert events (proto only for prototype)
Front-end will implement brieflet as lightweight React portal to avoid reflow in table rows
Telemetry: instrument click-through rate on 'Create Postmortem Stub' and 'Handoff' -> tracking keys: brieflet.create_stub, brieflet.handoff
Rollout: gated by org feature flag; add console-2026.03 release notes and admin toggle
